# Obsidian Template

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian template using the Templater plugin with JavaScript that determines the structure, layout, and configuration for various types of notes in the PKM system.

## Scope note

{% raw %}- Includes templates created with the Obsidian Templater plugin, with optional inline Templater expressions (`<% ... %>`) and JavaScript code.
- Distinguished from PKM Python templates using Jinja2 templates with Mustache syntax (`{{ ... }}`) that are used to generate Obsidian notes from Python (and/or Swift) services, scripts, commands, and agents.{% endraw %}
